title: Burnham Opens Debate on Return to EU Free Movement
dek: The prime minister says he is open to free movement but rules out the euro and Schengen.
body: Burnham told the Sunday Times he wants an evidence-based debate. Rayner says nothing is off the table.

panels.label: The Government Says
panels.text: Rayner says “you can't take anything off the table” and that voters should decide at a general election.

panels.label: The Opposition Says
panels.text: Badenoch says Burnham “hasn't thought this through”; Jenrick says the idea is “mad.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side says Brexit costs trade, the other that free movement costs control; at stake is who sets Britain's borders.
